signals.text: 6 open PM roles across 3 US offices
5 new PM roles posted this week

roles.title: Lead Product Manager, Capital Markets & Pricing

bullets: Set the strategy for capital markets and pricing, and get product, engineering, and our capital markets team aligned on where we compete and how we win on price. You’ll also help…
Own the roadmap for the pricing engine, product eligibility, rate locks, and secondary execution
Get us to the best pricing in the market by automating best execution across agency cash and MBS, aggregators, and whole loan buyers
Build pricing models and strategies with the rigor of a hedge fund, watching rate moves, spreads, investor appetite, and competitor pricing, and turning what you see into better…
Write and ship code yourself, from pricing models and analysis to changes in the pricing engine
Set the direction for every borrower and loan officer experience at Pylon, get product, design, and engineering aligned on it, and help grow the team as it scales
Own the roadmap for the borrower application, borrower dashboard, and loan officer experience
Build an application that only asks what it needs to, fills in whatever we can get automatically, and gets borrowers to a decision faster than anyone else
Keep borrowers up to date throughout the loan, with status, next steps, outstanding items, documents, disclosures, and closing, so they never have to call and ask what’s going on
Design the loan officer experience around the work that matters most, like managing their pipeline, talking with borrowers, running pricing scenarios, and resolving issues quickly
Set the API strategy across Pylon so every product and engineering team is building toward one consistent platform, and help grow the team as it scales
Own the roadmap and quality bar for the API. Developers are your main customers
Own the domain model. You’ll define the core entities, relationships, and lifecycle states of a mortgage, and keep the model clean as we add products, channels, and regulations
Lead GraphQL schema design, from types, queries, mutations, and subscriptions to pagination, errors, and naming, and set the standards other teams follow
Run API design review so new fields and mutations stay consistent and hold up over time
Set the direction for agents across Pylon and get product, engineering, and operations aligned on where they’ll make the biggest difference
Own the roadmap for the platform’s core pieces, like tools, orchestration, context and memory, retrieval, evals, observability, and guardrails
Make it much faster for internal teams to go from an idea to an agent running in production, and give them shared patterns so nobody builds the same thing twice
Treat evals as a product of their own. Teams should have shared datasets, benchmarks, and regression checks, plus human review wherever a regulated decision needs it
Own how external agents work with Pylon, including MCP servers, APIs, scoped permissions, rate limits, and docs that both people and LLMs can follow
Embed with strategic customers, on site and remotely, to understand their teams, systems, and full mortgage workflow
Map how each customer works today, figure out where Pylon adds the most value, and put together a plan that gets them live quickly
Own each integration from scoping and solution design through data mapping, configuration, testing, and launch, working with their engineers and ours
Find the manual steps, workarounds, and bottlenecks in each customer’s process and replace them with Pylon
Write and ship code yourself, including integrations, scripts, configurations, internal tools, and agents on our platform, and commit changes to our core codebase when a customer…
Challenge convention and the status quo – just because the market does something one way, doesn’t mean it’s the correct or most optimal way
Help onboard and manage 3rd party integrations
Leverage AI and LLMs in both your daily workflow (specs, designs, etc.), but also as a meaningful part of your solution space to solve problems
Be a thought partner and build a strong feedback loop with engineering
Play an integral role in spec-ing, building, and launching support for new loan products
